segments.name: Datacenter & Communications
segments.description: Supplies optical components, modules, subsystems and semiconductor devices for datacenter and communications customers.
segments.evidence: The Datacenter & Communications segment leverages our compound semiconductor technology platforms and deep knowledge of end-user applications for its key end markets to deliver differentiated components, modules, and subsystems.

segments.name: Industrial
products: Advanced ceramic and metal-matrix composite materials
segments.description: Provides lasers, optics and engineered materials to industrial, semiconductor and display capital equipment, precision manufacturing and instrumentation customers.
segments.evidence: The Industrial segment's lasers and optics products serve industrial customers in both semiconductor and display capital equipment and precision manufacturing, and instrumentation customers in life sciences and scientific instrumentation.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue by selling lasers, transceivers, optical devices and engineered materials to customers in datacenter, communications and industrial end markets.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate nearly all of our revenues, earnings, and cash flows from developing, manufacturing, and marketing a wide range of products and services for our end markets.
